_comment: Project-local pi settings. Canonical project resources live in .agents/ (skills, prompts, chains); pi discovers .agents/skills natively and reads the GENERATED .pi/prompts, .pi/agents and .pi/chains. Only .pi/extensions and this file are hand-authored. Run `.agents/harness sync` after editing anything under .agents/; don't enumerate resources here.
_envOverrides: The bash tool sources ./.agents/env.sh via shellCommandPrefix. That file is the canonical, harness-neutral environment contract: it sets TTRPG_* paths, sources project .env for optional feature/API keys, forces every cache project-local under .cache (index, xdg, uv, npm, huggingface, torch, vendor), sets QMD_LLAMA_GPU behaviour, and defines the qmd/qmd-cpu shell functions with lazy bootstrap. Correctness never depends on this prefix: .agents/bin/<tool> sources the same file, so tools work with no harness config at all. .agents/scripts/pi-launch.sh and .agents/scripts/pi-isolated.sh apply the same env for direct/manual use. Don't put secrets in settings.json; pi only does deep merge on JSON.
